mechanism: Keep one compact identity board continuously visible while the live evidence field proves the same subject through setup, acceleration, front profile, aerial comparison and a decisive skill. The board is a verification rail, not decoration: every live phase must test a different identity cue and return enough stable anchors for comparison.

invariants.rule: Keep one compact original identity board readable throughout.
invariants.ablation_failure: Without it, the piece becomes a generic sports montage.

invariants.rule: Give each live phase a different verification role.
invariants.purpose: Tests identity rather than repeating action.
invariants.ablation_failure: Repeated side running adds no new evidence.

invariants.rule: Preserve face, silhouette, costume logic and one color anchor under speed and foreshortening.
Include one wide comparison and one close deformation-heavy skill proof.
invariants.purpose: Tests both social separation and local detail.
invariants.ablation_failure: Only one camera scale cannot verify robust identity.

invariants.rule: Hold a final live result beside the unchanged board.
invariants.ablation_failure: A logo card cannot close the identity test.

slots.name: lead_subject
slots.constraint: An original stable subject or pair with a readable role.

slots.name: setting
slots.constraint: A new setting with fixed spatial anchors and no source-specific surface.

slots.name: escalation_variable
slots.constraint: One causal variable that changes through visible stages.

slots.name: performance_rule
slots.constraint: A restrained acting or motion rule that keeps the mechanism legible.

slots.name: camera_grammar
slots.constraint: An information order that proves each state without copying source shot boundaries.

slots.name: payoff
slots.constraint: A clean final physical, informational or social consequence.

slots.name: sound_family
slots.constraint: An original hierarchy of diegetic cues; no unsupported source-audio claim.

anti_copy_exclusions: source female hurdler and national colors
source exact board layout and race coverage
